meta.title: Piecing Recollections
meta.description: You soothed my pain with your hands and granted me salvation with your spirit.

units.rawText: ...Sigh. Now I think about it, you really scared me back there.
units.displayText: ...Sigh. Now I think about it, you really scared me back there.

spans.text: ...Sigh. Now I think about it, you really scared me back there.

units.rawText: You dashed into Sanctifiers with just a handgun... Please cut down on reckless stunts like that unless you intend to overload my neural cloud.
units.displayText: You dashed into Sanctifiers with just a handgun... Please cut down on reckless stunts like that unless you intend to overload my neural cloud.

spans.text: You dashed into Sanctifiers with just a handgun... Please cut down on reckless stunts like that unless you intend to overload my neural cloud.

units.rawText: I'd make the exact same choice if I were placed in the same situation again and again.
units.displayText: I'd make the exact same choice if I were placed in the same situation again and again.

spans.text: I'd make the exact same choice if I were placed in the same situation again and again.

units.rawText: ...Yeah, I know, and probably understand that all too well...
units.displayText: ...Yeah, I know, and probably understand that all too well...

spans.text: ...Yeah, I know, and probably understand that all too well...

units.rawText: That's also why I think you're "special".
units.displayText: That's also why I think you're "special".

spans.text: That's also why I think you're "special".

units.rawText: Sangoma releases the coiled strand of hair from her fingertip and beams at me.
units.displayText: Sangoma releases the coiled strand of hair from her fingertip and beams at me.

spans.text: Sangoma releases the coiled strand of hair from her fingertip and beams at me.

units.rawText: Looks like my story has helped you regain your memory.
units.displayText: Looks like my story has helped you regain your memory.

spans.text: Looks like my story has helped you regain your memory.

units.rawText: Yes, it's more effective than I had anticipated.
units.displayText: Yes, it's more effective than I had anticipated.

spans.text: Yes, it's more effective than I had anticipated.

units.rawText: I show the memory fragment to Sangoma.
units.displayText: I show the memory fragment to Sangoma.

spans.text: I show the memory fragment to Sangoma.

units.rawText: A thin block of light fills the gap in the fragment, pulsing gently as if it were breathing.
units.displayText: A thin block of light fills the gap in the fragment, pulsing gently as if it were breathing.

spans.text: A thin block of light fills the gap in the fragment, pulsing gently as if it were breathing.

units.rawText: I also remembered many moments we shared together while you were recounting the story.
units.displayText: I also remembered many moments we shared together while you were recounting the story.

spans.text: I also remembered many moments we shared together while you were recounting the story.

units.rawText: My familiarity with that fragrance wasn't a hallucination. But how could I have forgotten you, but not the scent?
units.displayText: My familiarity with that fragrance wasn't a hallucination. But how could I have forgotten you, but not the scent?

spans.text: My familiarity with that fragrance wasn't a hallucination. But how could I have forgotten you, but not the scent?

units.rawText: Sangoma's smile falters slightly, touched by a faint trace of disappointment.
units.displayText: Sangoma's smile falters slightly, touched by a faint trace of disappointment.

spans.text: Sangoma's smile falters slightly, touched by a faint trace of disappointment.

units.rawText: ...We should move on. Let's find Persicaria next.
units.displayText: ...We should move on. Let's find Persicaria next.

spans.text: ...We should move on. Let's find Persicaria next.

units.rawText: Nonetheless, she's the one who witnessed the battle, and she knows what the aftermath was much better than me...
units.displayText: Nonetheless, she's the one who witnessed the battle, and she knows what the aftermath was much better than me...

spans.text: Nonetheless, she's the one who witnessed the battle, and she knows what the aftermath was much better than me...

units.rawText: I've finished my part. Now it's her turn to guide you to the next part of your memory.
units.displayText: I've finished my part. Now it's her turn to guide you to the next part of your memory.

spans.text: I've finished my part. Now it's her turn to guide you to the next part of your memory.

units.rawText: The Oasis, Archive.
units.displayText: The Oasis, Archive.

spans.text: The Oasis, Archive.

units.rawText: Coming in.
units.displayText: Coming in.

spans.text: Coming in.

units.rawText: Ah, you've arrived at the perfect time, Professor. Have you checked the Doll list and your appointment schedule? I sent them to you not long ago.
units.displayText: Ah, you've arrived at the perfect time, Professor. Have you checked the Doll list and your appointment schedule? I sent them to you not long ago.

spans.text: Ah, you've arrived at the perfect time, Professor. Have you checked the Doll list and your appointment schedule? I sent them to you not long ago.

units.rawText: Mm-hmm. I've spoken with the first batch of Exiles. Thank you for your hard work, Persicaria.
units.displayText: Mm-hmm. I've spoken with the first batch of Exiles. Thank you for your hard work, Persicaria.

spans.text: Mm-hmm. I've spoken with the first batch of Exiles. Thank you for your hard work, Persicaria.

units.rawText: It's nothing. I simply sorted the Dolls by their arrival order in the Oasis, factoring in their conditions and making the necessary accommodations.
units.displayText: It's nothing. I simply sorted the Dolls by their arrival order in the Oasis, factoring in their conditions and making the necessary accommodations.

spans.text: It's nothing. I simply sorted the Dolls by their arrival order in the Oasis, factoring in their conditions and making the necessary accommodations.

units.rawText: Besides that, I've been searching for references on memory recovery and I've found many that could be helpful to you.
units.displayText: Besides that, I've been searching for references on memory recovery and I've found many that could be helpful to you.

spans.text: Besides that, I've been searching for references on memory recovery and I've found many that could be helpful to you.

units.rawText: Thank you. We've come here to inform you that your theory has been proven correct. The memory fragment can indeed be repaired by recounting the past through conversations.
units.displayText: Thank you. We've come here to inform you that your theory has been proven correct. The memory fragment can indeed be repaired by recounting the past through conversations.

spans.text: Thank you. We've come here to inform you that your theory has been proven correct. The memory fragment can indeed be repaired by recounting the past through conversations.

units.rawText: That's great news... Wait a second, what do you mean by "we"?
units.displayText: That's great news... Wait a second, what do you mean by "we"?

spans.text: That's great news... Wait a second, what do you mean by "we"?

units.rawText: My, it's great news indeed. Hi there~
units.displayText: My, it's great news indeed. Hi there~

spans.text: My, it's great news indeed. Hi there~

units.rawText: Joy vanishes from Persicaria's face, replaced by doubt as she looks at the purple-haired Doll before her.
units.displayText: Joy vanishes from Persicaria's face, replaced by doubt as she looks at the purple-haired Doll before her.

spans.text: Joy vanishes from Persicaria's face, replaced by doubt as she looks at the purple-haired Doll before her.

units.rawText: Relax, Persicaria. I did get some important memories back with Sangoma's help.
units.displayText: Relax, Persicaria. I did get some important memories back with Sangoma's help.

spans.text: Relax, Persicaria. I did get some important memories back with Sangoma's help.

units.rawText: Like the vital period between my arrival at the Cloud and the moment I met you...
units.displayText: Like the vital period between my arrival at the Cloud and the moment I met you...

spans.text: Like the vital period between my arrival at the Cloud and the moment I met you...

units.rawText: You managed to remember that battle?!
units.displayText: You managed to remember that battle?!

spans.text: You managed to remember that battle?!

units.rawText: Unfortunately, the memory only goes up to the moment I found you. I was hoping you could fill in the rest for me.
units.displayText: Unfortunately, the memory only goes up to the moment I found you. I was hoping you could fill in the rest for me.

spans.text: Unfortunately, the memory only goes up to the moment I found you. I was hoping you could fill in the rest for me.

units.rawText: Persicaria eyes Sangoma cautiously, while Sangoma gazes at us with a playful grin.
units.displayText: Persicaria eyes Sangoma cautiously, while Sangoma gazes at us with a playful grin.

spans.text: Persicaria eyes Sangoma cautiously, while Sangoma gazes at us with a playful grin.

units.rawText: ...Professor, can I talk to you for a second?
units.displayText: ...Professor, can I talk to you for a second?

spans.text: ...Professor, can I talk to you for a second?

units.rawText: Persicaria drags me over to a corner, deliberately distancing us from Sangoma.
units.displayText: Persicaria drags me over to a corner, deliberately distancing us from Sangoma.

spans.text: Persicaria drags me over to a corner, deliberately distancing us from Sangoma.

units.rawText: Professor, Sangoma knows far too much about you and the Oasis. Don't you find that suspicious?
units.displayText: Professor, Sangoma knows far too much about you and the Oasis. Don't you find that suspicious?

spans.text: Professor, Sangoma knows far too much about you and the Oasis. Don't you find that suspicious?

units.rawText: You're not wrong. I suppose she might've worked with the Oasis at a deeper level.
units.displayText: You're not wrong. I suppose she might've worked with the Oasis at a deeper level.

spans.text: You're not wrong. I suppose she might've worked with the Oasis at a deeper level.

units.rawText: That's what I've assumed as well. Then we should be able to find traces of her somewhere, whether you remember her or not.
units.displayText: That's what I've assumed as well. Then we should be able to find traces of her somewhere, whether you remember her or not.

spans.text: That's what I've assumed as well. Then we should be able to find traces of her somewhere, whether you remember her or not.

units.rawText: However, I've gone through every record we have at the Oasis and asked the early members of the Exiles, but there's not even a single trace of her. No one knows anything about her.
units.displayText: However, I've gone through every record we have at the Oasis and asked the early members of the Exiles, but there's not even a single trace of her. No one knows anything about her.

spans.text: However, I've gone through every record we have at the Oasis and asked the early members of the Exiles, but there's not even a single trace of her. No one knows anything about her.

units.rawText: ...It's as if her existence has been deliberately concealed by someone.
units.displayText: ...It's as if her existence has been deliberately concealed by someone.

spans.text: ...It's as if her existence has been deliberately concealed by someone.

units.rawText: I don't know why she's hiding her identity, but if she can't be fully honest with us, then we'll have to stay cautious around her.
units.displayText: I don't know why she's hiding her identity, but if she can't be fully honest with us, then we'll have to stay cautious around her.

spans.text: I don't know why she's hiding her identity, but if she can't be fully honest with us, then we'll have to stay cautious around her.

units.rawText: ...You've got a point.
units.displayText: ...You've got a point.

spans.text: ...You've got a point.

units.rawText: Sensing my doubt and hesitation, Persicaria realizes her words could be construed in a different fashion. She looks into my eyes and gently takes my hands.
units.displayText: Sensing my doubt and hesitation, Persicaria realizes her words could be construed in a different fashion. She looks into my eyes and gently takes my hands.

spans.text: Sensing my doubt and hesitation, Persicaria realizes her words could be construed in a different fashion. She looks into my eyes and gently takes my hands.

units.rawText: I'm not saying you have to reveal everything about yourself as well... You, and only you, are the exception.
units.displayText: I'm not saying you have to reveal everything about yourself as well... You, and only you, are the exception.

spans.text: I'm not saying you have to reveal everything about yourself as well... You, and only you, are the exception.

units.rawText: Our long journey together has shown me exactly who you are at heart.
units.displayText: Our long journey together has shown me exactly who you are at heart.

spans.text: Our long journey together has shown me exactly who you are at heart.

units.rawText: I know you must have your reasons for hiding your true self, and I won't pry into it.
units.displayText: I know you must have your reasons for hiding your true self, and I won't pry into it.

spans.text: I know you must have your reasons for hiding your true self, and I won't pry into it.

units.rawText: Regardless of who you really are, no matter what happens, you will always be our "Professor," and I'll always trust you.
units.displayText: Regardless of who you really are, no matter what happens, you will always be our "Professor," and I'll always trust you.

spans.text: Regardless of who you really are, no matter what happens, you will always be our "Professor," and I'll always trust you.

units.rawText: Feeling Persicaria's utmost trust within my heart, I gently hold her hands in return.
units.displayText: Feeling Persicaria's utmost trust within my heart, I gently hold her hands in return.

spans.text: Feeling Persicaria's utmost trust within my heart, I gently hold her hands in return.

units.rawText: ...Thanks for warning me, Persicaria. I'll be more careful.
units.displayText: ...Thanks for warning me, Persicaria. I'll be more careful.

spans.text: ...Thanks for warning me, Persicaria. I'll be more careful.

units.rawText: —What's up? Have you finished your secret little chat?
units.displayText: —What's up? Have you finished your secret little chat?

spans.text: —What's up? Have you finished your secret little chat?

units.rawText: On the other side, Sangoma interrupts our conversation, smiling and waving at me.
units.displayText: On the other side, Sangoma interrupts our conversation, smiling and waving at me.

spans.text: On the other side, Sangoma interrupts our conversation, smiling and waving at me.

units.rawText: Yeah, it's over.
units.displayText: Yeah, it's over.

spans.text: Yeah, it's over.

units.rawText: Persicaria quietly pinches my hand, as if to remind me once again to stay cautious. We then return to the table in the archive room.
units.displayText: Persicaria quietly pinches my hand, as if to remind me once again to stay cautious. We then return to the table in the archive room.

spans.text: Persicaria quietly pinches my hand, as if to remind me once again to stay cautious. We then return to the table in the archive room.

units.rawText: ...I suppose it's my turn to tell the story after I met the Professor?
units.displayText: ...I suppose it's my turn to tell the story after I met the Professor?

spans.text: ...I suppose it's my turn to tell the story after I met the Professor?

units.rawText: Persicaria, I know it's not easy for you to recount this. If it's too painful—
units.displayText: Persicaria, I know it's not easy for you to recount this. If it's too painful—

spans.text: Persicaria, I know it's not easy for you to recount this. If it's too painful—

units.rawText: Persicaria gently shakes her head, stopping me before I can finish my sentence.
units.displayText: Persicaria gently shakes her head, stopping me before I can finish my sentence.

spans.text: Persicaria gently shakes her head, stopping me before I can finish my sentence.

units.rawText: <color=orange>...How could it ever be painful? Meeting you was my salvation, and it's something I'm grateful for, more than anything else in my life.</color>
units.displayText: ...How could it ever be painful? Meeting you was my salvation, and it's something I'm grateful for, more than anything else in my life.

spans.text: ...How could it ever be painful? Meeting you was my salvation, and it's something I'm grateful for, more than anything else in my life.
